sources.quote: A supplier may deliver a part only if the approved supplier list contains an approval for that

findings.why: The approved supplier list covers SP-700 at PLT-BEI for CUST-AUR, and the only approval is for SUP-F. There is no approval for SUP-G. SUP-G's capabilities also list no PA66-GF30. Approval is per part, so the approvals SUP-G holds for other parts do not carry over.

sources.quote: The supplier shall obtain written approval from Aurelia (PPAP resubmission) before shipping parts
Aurelia shall be notified of every planned change at least 90 days before implementation.

findings.why: SP-700 belongs to PRG-Z, which is an Aurelia program. A change of source needs Aurelia's written approval (PPAP) before shipment, and 90 days' notice. Revision 4 replaces revision 3. No approval in the documents covers this change.

sources.quote: A change of source requires a material certificate (EN 10204 type 3.1) from the new supplier for

findings.why: SUP-G has 3.1 certificates only for DC04, C67S and 42CrMo4. There is none for PA66-GF30, the drawing material of SP-700. The supplier quality engineer (Elena Gallo) needs to obtain or confirm one.
